suread: review R1 素读（只读 text/，未开 md）

facts.fact: 办公室开场：半掩窗帘与纸堆
facts.anchor: Daylight streamed into Gazzie’s office through half-closed curtains
the caged hatchling statue still sat in the same spot

facts.fact: 她怀疑自己记错：上次来嘴是闭着的
facts.anchor: its mouth had been closed during my prior visit but wrote off my memory as faulty

facts.fact: 距听家族起源故事已三周多
facts.anchor: over three weeks since I’d heard our family’s origin story

facts.fact: Ida 画像：绿墙前的苍白皮肤
facts.anchor: In her portraits, Ida’s skin shimmered, pale against the green walls

facts.fact: 金箔已修复、画匠小车收起
facts.anchor: The gold leaf on all her frames had been repaired, the artist’s cart tucked away somewhere.
reading glasses perched on the end of her nose
I feel like I’ve been called to the principal’s office.
Since waking from my nap Monday, I’d been nervous about seeing her

facts.fact: 一周没来办公室、短信指挥除葛藤与藻
facts.anchor: I drove myself under texted instructions to clear out the kudzu and the algae
while she and Harrison “dealt with things.”
Nova’s words wormed themselves deeper into my mind
Was she saying my grandmother had killed a person?

facts.fact: 暴力可想象、杀人另当别论
facts.anchor: I’d already known Gazzie was capable of violence, of dangerous crimes, but murder was something else entirely

facts.fact: Leon 最后的速写本行文与恐慌
facts.anchor: Hearing the accusation so soon after reading Uncle Leon’s last sketchbook entry had kicked my panic into overdrive

facts.fact: 「她是说我祖母杀了 Leon 叔叔？」
facts.anchor: Was she saying my grandmother had killed Uncle Leon?

facts.fact: 农场没连着别的死（鳄鱼除外）
facts.anchor: No other deaths—besides those of countless alligators—were connected to the farm
But both Gazzie and Aunt Virginia had told me that was an accident

facts.fact: Virginia 只撒过一次谎、重要的事不会撒
facts.anchor: surely she wouldn’t lie about something so important
Nova must have been referring to the alligators.

facts.fact: 自认变好了、不能被凶手带坏
facts.anchor: I had changed, become a better person. I couldn’t afford to be influenced by an actual murderer.
We have her.

facts.fact: HR 档案里的地址、回家找律师
facts.anchor: Her address was in her HR file. Apparently, she went home and lawyered up.
Said she had nothing to do with any of it.

facts.fact: 「那我们没抓到她」＋一周就这成果
facts.anchor: That’s all Gazzie had come up with after a full week away from the farm?

facts.fact: 「只有 guilty 的人才请律师」
facts.anchor: Only guilty people hire lawyers. Harrison’s working with my contact at the police.

facts.fact: Harrison 名字引发一阵紧张
facts.anchor: Harrison’s name sent a bolt of nervous energy through me

facts.fact: 她以为会直接审出帮凶（大概是 Joe）
facts.anchor: discover the accomplice—presumably Joe—but they hadn’t
Breaking and entering. Property damage.

facts.fact: Gazzie 的重罪论：attempted voluntary manslaughter
facts.anchor: Sounds like attempted voluntary manslaughter to me.

facts.fact: 推人不告就不算，她不想告
facts.anchor: Pushing past me might have been assault, but only if I pressed charges, and I didn’t want to.
Not a clue.
She seemed a little too nonchalant.
we’ll make her talk eventually
Given the accomplice had outsmarted Gazzie multiple times already, her confidence surprised me.
There will always be problems at the farm. We’ll deal with them as they come.

facts.fact: Ironheart 又来了：祖母仍信超自然元凶
facts.anchor: She still believed an imaginary creature was behind the vandalism, even after identifying an actual human culprit.

facts.fact: 残余疑点清单＋「有脑子去忽略」
facts.anchor: I also had the good sense to ignore them
I want to talk about the solstice party in two weeks.
I’m announcing my heir.

facts.fact: 「Harrison 是好孩子，但他不是家人」
facts.anchor: Harrison’s a good kid. Hard worker. Holds his liquor. But he’s not family.
With those words, I knew: She wanted me.
My mind drifted back to his lips on my cheek

facts.fact: 十年前一夜情之外第一个对她有意思的男人
facts.anchor: he was the first man who’d shown any interest in me, other than my one-night stand a decade ago

facts.fact: 家族之外第一个真正注意到她的人
facts.anchor: he was the first person outside my family who’d really noticed me
A real kiss.
She considered Aunt Virginia’s romance a distraction; she’d think the same of mine.
“He’s helped me learn the ropes,” I said weakly.
But now you’re here. And Monday, you showed real dedication.
I’d like to consider you for the position.
if she’d spoken them three weeks earlier, I’d have burst into tears
She’s a killer.

facts.fact: 不要客套、要她回答扛不扛得住
facts.anchor: I don’t want a thank-you or a mealymouthed compliment. I need you to tell me whether you can handle the job.

facts.fact: 不是给继承权、只是给争的机会
facts.anchor: She wasn’t even offering me the inheritance, just a chance to try for it.

facts.fact: 雕像慢慢张嘴、Gazzie 开笼
facts.anchor: the statue slowly opened its mouth
It’s real,” I whispered.
Of course it’s real.
I thought it was a statue.
She’s hungry.

facts.fact: Ziploc 袋里的死蟋蟀、四口吞下
facts.anchor: she extracted a dead thumb-sized cricket

facts.fact: 老式马戏团笼子＋缺水缺灯的疑虑
facts.anchor: An old-fashioned circus cage, no less.
went to a cart by the fireplace
chirping in what I can only describe as a demanding tone. Sassy.
she held the kettle above the hatchling’s cage and tipped it.
Through the black film stretching across my vision, I saw a thin stream of water pour over the alligator.
“They like boiling water?” I asked
Did you know they don’t age? Negligible senescence, it’s called.

facts.fact: 我们就是它们唯一的天敌（外加它们自己）
facts.anchor: And we’re their only predators. Well, us and themselves.
“They eat one another,” I confirmed, astonished.

facts.fact: 「母亲连孩子都吃，尤其是幼崽」
facts.anchor: Mothers even eat their children. Babies, especially.
Gazzie had confined the creature to a life of captivity, then made it love its cage.
Now, do you think you’re up to the job?

facts.fact: 「我来这就是为了这份继承权」＋生来如此
facts.anchor: I’d come to Amelia Island for this inheritance, even if I hadn’t known about it yet.
“Yes,” I said as firmly as I could.

facts.fact: Ida 笑得更开、空气开始震颤
facts.anchor: I could have sworn her smile wasn’t that wide before. As I leaned forward, the air began to thrum.
Now, this is not a guarantee. I have to see how much you want it.
Anger snapped through me, tight as a bowstring.

facts.fact: 不置可否地哼、隔笼抚幼鳄
facts.anchor: She hummed noncommittally, stroking the hatchling’s side through its cage bars.
Did she want me to kill an alligator with my bare hands?
I liked having that safety net, knowing I could return to Savannah if Gazzie threw me out.
But what are you willing to sacrifice for us? For the Greers?

facts.fact: Ida 催她服从＋太阳穴痛
facts.anchor: pain streaked through my temple, like someone was squeezing my head between their hands

facts.fact: 全身的纤维都说这是错，嘴上仍答应
facts.anchor: Although every fiber of my being told me that I was making a mistake
As soon as I agreed, my head stopped hurting.
You’ll be on our private plan. Our accountant will handle that and the apartment.

facts.fact: 别的员工没保险的负罪感
facts.anchor: repressing a twinge of guilt that I’d have insurance while the other employees would not
“Ida will be pleased.”

facts.fact: 曾曾祖母的黑眼与猎犬皮带
facts.anchor: She gripped the leashes of her hunting dogs, that wicked smile curling the edge of her lips.
